sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Guard or tackle? Tyler Smith says he's comfortable with Cowboys' plans for him
sources.description: Cowboys offensive lineman Tyler Smith has been a guard for most of his career, but he has at times played left tackle, including the final three games of last season.
